column1: # Game profile of 信長の野望·新生 (NOBUNAGA'S AMBITION: Shinsei; Switch, update v65536 = 1.0.1, Japanese, Simplified and Traditional
# Chinese, no English). Plays on a Lenovo Legion Y700 (Android 16, Adreno 750) with Mesa's Turnip: the opening movies, the tutorial's
# new game, the faction select, the campaign map, a retainer's advice, an in-game save and the pause menu, at 30 fps as on the Switch.
# Koei Tecmo's KTGL on NVN, SDK 13.3.2. Modules main + subsdk1 (NintendoSDK_movie: the .n16 opening and event movies) + sdk; subsdk0
# is GLSLC, which main never loads (it imports no nn::ro::LoadModule and no glslcCompile): every shader is precompiled, 69 GLSLC outputs
# in main and 880 in RES/res_shader.bin. The profile asks for Turnip (android.tsv vulkan_driver turnip): the Adreno 750's own driver
# (512.762.40) crashes in its LLVM compiler on the game's compute shaders, which use subgroup ballot; Turnip builds all 70.
# Game name: only a label for profile listings and the Mac window title; the Android app's name is this one unless --app-name is given
# load order as on Horizon: main, subsdk*, sdk (subsdk1 = NintendoSDK_movie)
# RES holds the engine's res_*.bin archives (res_shader.bin among them) and the STAGE / MOVIE (.n16) / SNDRES data; MSG/{JP,SC,TC}
# and RES_{JP,SC,TC} are the three languages, chosen by the language the app packs
# the archives are read by offset, so .bin stays uncompressed (RES is 2.7 GB)
# main sets a heap of at most the pool − 64 MB: a 3328 MB heap region (the log's "heap 3.14 GB (heap region 3.25 GB)"). The NPDM
# declares no system resource (0 MB), so IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is false, as on Horizon.
